text:
marco: quick sync — billing vs Console mismatch still happening for a few large tenants. root cause looks like inconsistent quota headers from clients.

Tess: which header are clients sending?

marco: variety. legacy `X-Redwood-Quota-Key: tenant/123` vs new `X-RW-Quota-Bucket: tenant/123/route/chat/model/gptx`. runtime accepts both but billing uses the bucketed form.

alicia: product impact is obvious. customers see different numbers in Console vs invoice. we need a short-term UI warning + long-term fix.

sam: runtime: we can map legacy keys to v2 buckets heuristically, but it's lossy. better to have SDKs send canonical bucket. also need telemetry to measure adoption.

pj: SDK plan: ship minor patch that sets `X-RW-Quota-Bucket` while keeping legacy header for 8 weeks. add env var `RW_QUOTA_STRICT=true` to opt into strict mode for testing.

zara: ops asks for a `quota.bucket_version` tag on telemetry so we can graph v1 vs v2 traffic. also create `quota.bucket_mismatch` event when we see legacy header but billing expects v2.

Tess: Console: add banner when tenant's bucketed vs legacy attribution differs >5% and CTA linking to SDK upgrade instructions.

alicia: comms: draft customer notice explaining the migration and deadline. coordinate with billing for any disputes.

marco: small implementation note: Go's net/http canonicalizes header keys; make sure SDKs set header via canonical helper so runtime logging matches.

pj: good catch — we'll add tests for header casing in Go/TS/Python CI.

sam: telemetry sampling: default 0.5% for `quota.attribution`, increase if debugging. include `bucket_key`, `method` (header|server), `resolved_model`.

marco: action items:
- pj: SDK header helper + PRs (owner)
- sam: telemetry tags/events (owner)
- tess: Console banner + CTA (owner)
- zara: ops runbook for shadow charge + mismatch alerts (owner)
- alicia: customer comms + billing sync (owner)

marco: thanks — please +1 when you own the item. leaving thread open for reviews.
